blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, the official JPYSC proxy resolved to verified StablecoinV1 implementation 0xba161409749ae95e9bbc1cf3a2dd3fe3e0af1d5e and paused() was false. Verified source gives the current blacklister 0xba1fb3b95cdea5c62dc7c83a9ac8c704160d2356 address-level blacklist/unblacklist power, the pauser 0xf30a72ba1fb9de61a1531fd8a691d046d425ae32 global pause power, and the seizer 0x90de37a09222f08ead6de034aa84dfcddf9ca560 court-order forced-transfer power after an address is blacklisted. Holder transfers enforce both the pause and blacklist gates.

oracleRisk.summary: JPYSC is a trust-bank-issued yen instrument sold and repurchased at a fixed 1 JPYSC = 1 JPY par through SBI VC Trade against segregated trust assets (yen demand deposits, with JGBs permitted up to 50%). The verified StablecoinV1 implementation exposes no oracle or price-feed surface, and no CDP or lending branch prices JPYSC or any collateral against it; the tracked price is peg-derived, not oracle- or market-discovered.

branchApplicability.rationale: JPYSC is a fiat-cash, Type III trust-bank instrument: SBI VC Trade's product page fixes purchase and repurchase at 1 JPYSC = 1 yen with zero spread and no price deviating from par inside the account environment, and reserves sit in segregated Shinsei Trust & Banking trust accounts (yen demand deposits; short-term JGBs permitted up to 50% under the amended PSA trust-type rules). The verified StablecoinV1 implementation ABI (Blockscout, fetched 2026-08-08) contains no oracle, price, feed, or rate function. Circulation is closed-loop inside verified SBI VC Trade accounts with external-wallet withdrawals disabled, so no DeFi lending market or CDP branch consumes a JPYSC price feed; SBI VC Trade's own JPYSC Lending is an off-chain consumer-loan product, not an oracle-liquidated borrowing branch. There is no borrower debt, collateral ratio, liquidation mechanism, backstop, or bad-debt surface to model — branch knowability surfaces do not apply.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JPYSC has one tracked deployment: the Ethereum ERC1967 UUPS proxy 0x6781d5631bfe47432b089e64e3eab3b6edd26177 resolving to the verified StablecoinV1 implementation. SBI VC Trade lists Ethereum as its only supported network, and JPYSC currently circulates closed-loop inside verified SBI VC Trade accounts with external-wallet withdrawals disabled, so no bridge carries durable supply. Announced Strium and Soneium expansions were not live as of this review.
